column5: If a road casualty has suffered fractures to the limbs, you should cover any wounds with clean material.

column5: If a road casualty has suffered fractures to the limbs, you should immobilize them and immediately afterwards, if necessary, apply the normal anti-shock measures.

column5: If a road casualty has suffered fractures to the limbs, you should try to make them walk to reduce the pain.

column5: If a road casualty has suffered fractures to the limbs, you should ask them to move them in order to assess the type of injury.

column5: If a road casualty has been burned and there are still some remaining flames, you should wait for them to go out on their own before intervening.
